name: Database foundation
summary: Somewhere to keep your information, with a health check that tells you when it is not reachable.

provenance.changes: Written for the Shipyard starter stack.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Where your database lives. Shipyard runs one on your machine for you.

extensionPoints.description: Your own tables go below the component markers.

postInstall: Run the database update so the new tables exist — Shipyard can do this for you.
limitations: The health check tells you the database answered. It does not tell you the data is correct.
No backup or restore. That is a separate decision and a separate check.
solves: keep information so it is still there tomorrow
health check to see if the app is up
